views.title: Isometric
criteria: Capsule base with two bolt flanges is visible
Central housing/boss is visible above the base
Shaft bore opening is visible on the boss
Part is not clipped; axes labels readable

views.title: Front (XZ)
views.note: bore is not thru the plane
criteria: Base sits along the bottom of the view
Shaft bore appears as a circle (or clear round opening) through the boss
Overall height shows base + boss (not a flat plate only)
Left/right flange ends are visible

views.title: Top (XY)
criteria: Capsule / dog-bone base outline is clear
Two bolt holes are visible, spaced along the long axis
Central body/boss footprint is centered between the bolts
No obvious mesh explosion or missing halves

views.title: Right (YZ)
views.note: bore is thru plane, ought to be left/right in this plane
criteria: Base thickness is visible as a horizontal slab
Boss/housing rises above the base
Shaft-axis direction is into/out of the page (round boss profile)
Geometry is coherent (not an empty frame)

views.title: 2D profile (DXF)
views.note: there ought to be only two flang holes.  the bole incorrectly goes thru this plane
criteria: Black linework on white background (not blank / not white-on-white)
Capsule outline with two rounded ends
Two bolt-hole circles at flange centers
One central bore circle
Clean 2D drawing (not a messy 3D edge projection)
